scope: Coordinated semantic audit of native selector contracts and retained Variable expression forms; this is evidence, not runtime qualification.
baseline_policy: Use pinned OVAL 5.12.3 semantics. Do not infer runtime support from schema or conversion output.

scap_ng_prs.role: retained Variable function documentation and audit

variable_forms.name: literal
variable_forms.finding: Converter emits typed literal components and constant literal arrays; no value execution.

variable_forms.name: variable
variable_forms.finding: Converter emits named Variable references and preserves variable declarations.

variable_forms.name: values
variable_forms.finding: object_component emits a collected Object-field projection; field resolution is validated, not executed.

variable_forms.name: concat
variable_forms.finding: Converter requires at least two children and preserves child order; no Cartesian product is evaluated.

variable_forms.name: regex_capture
variable_forms.finding: Converter requires one child and a pattern and emits the pattern unchanged; regex matching is not executed.

variable_forms.name: unique
variable_forms.finding: Converter and active schema accept one expression; pinned OVAL UniqueFunctionType permits one or more components.

variable_forms.name: merge
variable_forms.finding: Converter requires one child and materializes delimiter/sort/order defaults; no sorting or join is executed.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Concat over multi-valued components is expected to preserve source collection semantics; pinned XSD defines arity/types but is not an evaluator.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: No evaluator found. Converter explicitly does not evaluate products and refuses an unproved constant-array function boundary.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Retain OVAL lexical casting and declared datatype behavior.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: Literal parsing, native datatype mapping, same-datatype variable operands, and narrow local lexical string-to-integer/float validation are implemented; runtime cast behavior is absent.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Preserve component order and source population order unless an explicit retained/native operation orders values.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: Converter preserves expression child order and emits merge sort/order; it does not execute merge or prove provider ordering.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Do not turn missing/nonexistent or collection statuses into ordinary literal values.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: Conversion comments and failure checks preserve boundaries, but no runtime population/status engine exists in either repository.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Preserve source errors and evaluation outcomes; conversion-time malformed references remain failures.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: Converter fails closed on malformed/unsupported source structures; evaluator error propagation is not implemented.

semantic_axes.oval_baseline: Preserve source regex and case-sensitive/case-insensitive operation semantics.
semantic_axes.verified_implementation: Selector operation crosswalk emits matches_regex and explicit case operators; regex_capture pattern is copied unchanged; no regex engine execution was found.
